zh: 会话切换更顺滑：皮肤在使用中会反复翻转的页面标记（首页形态、页头提升、页签栏置顶、竖屏适配、阅读暂停、输入区随页签隐藏，以及上下文圆盘的尺寸读数）从 `<body>` 下移到最近的公共祖先元素上。此前这些属性上悬挂着一千二百余条选择器，每写一次整个文档都要重新参与样式匹配；实测改版后，会话之间、会话与首页之间的切换对 `<body>` 的属性与内联样式写入降为零，样式失效范围收敛到对应子树。
en: Smoother conversation switches: the page marks the skin flips during normal use (the home layout's hero mark, the header band lift, the titlebar tabs, the mobile portrait adaptation, the reader's scroll hold, the composer hiding with the conversation tab, and the context meter's measured numbers) moved from `<body>` to the nearest element that ancestors every styled target. Over twelve hundred selectors used to hang off those body attributes, so every write re-matched the whole document; measured on this build, a switch between conversations or between a conversation and the home page now writes zero attributes and zero inline styles on `<body>`, and style invalidation stays inside the subtree that changed.
